findings.message: The client-supplied name is joined to UPLOAD_DIR without validation, so `?file=../../etc/passwd` or an absolute path reads any file the process can access (path traversal), and nothing ties the file to the requesting user.
Uploads are arbitrary bytes (avatars are PNGs), so `.decode()` raises UnicodeDecodeError for any non-UTF-8 file and the download fails with a server error instead of returning the file.
